F001.acceptance: A parametrized test loads ActionItems from all producer paths (provider functions, Guidance.to_action_items, _rendered_to_action_item_dict) and asserts: (a) every item carries audience, dedupe_key, reversible, plain_consequence, dashboard_url; (b) no safe_command field exists and exact_command+automatable encode command safety; (c) dedupe_key is producer-set and dedup (merge_with_event_sidecar + fleet aggregation) keys on dedupe_key, not id-prefix; (d) ActionItem rejects an unvalidated exact_command at construction. Full orchestrate sweep stays green.

F002.acceptance: `agent status --json` reports can_operate / can_be_dispatched / can_orchestrate as three independent booleans; a test asserts Grok → (true,false,*) with the brief rendering operate-but-not-dispatch wording, a registered worker → can_be_dispatched=true, and that no tree-budget/governance module is imported or invoked by F002 code (absence assertion). Full orchestrate sweep stays green.

F003.acceptance: One test feeds a fixed ActionItem set through all three renderers and asserts the same action (matched by dedupe_key) appears in each with consistent title/band/exact_command, deduped once, with secret-shaped substrings scrubbed at the boundary. No renderer constructs ActionItems independently of the spine. Full orchestrate sweep stays green.
